fields.spec_version: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (21-Feb-2008, MIPI Board Approved 18-Jun-2008)
previous_versions: DSI v1.0 — earlier release; did NOT support EoTp Short Packet.

key_changes_in_v1_01.summary: Added EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload 0x0F0F, ECC 0x01) as a protocol-layer end-of-HS-transmission marker, decoupling end-of-transmission detection from PHY characteristics.
Mandated EoTp generation/detection capability with implementation-specific enable/disable for backward compatibility with v1.0 peripherals.
Aligned with D-PHY v0.90.00 (8-Oct-2007) as the physical layer reference, plus DBI-2 v2.00, DPI-2 v2.00, and DCS v1.02.00 (in-press at the time of v1.01.00 release).

referenced_external_specifications.spec: MIPI Alliance Specification for Display Command Set (DCS), version 1.02.00, In Press.
MIPI Alliance Standard for Display Bus Interface (DBI-2), version 2.00, 29 November 2005.
MIPI Alliance Standard for Display Pixel Interface (DPI-2), version 2.00, 15 September 2005.
MIPI Alliance Specification for D-PHY, version 0.90.00, 8 October 2007.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Devices compliant with DSI v1.0 do NOT support EoTp generation or detection. v1.01-compliant devices SHALL implement EoTp AND provide a means to enable / disable EoTp generation / detection.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Pairing v1.01 device that always sends EoTp with v1.0 peripheral that does not recognize DT=0x08 results in DSI DT Not Recognized error (Error Report bit 11) and lost packet boundary in remainder of transmission.

backward_compat_traps.rule: EoTp SHOULD NOT be sent when transmitting in LP mode.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Sending EoTp in LP causes peripheral to flag DSI Protocol Violation (Error Report bit 15) or DSI DT Not Recognized.

backward_compat_traps.rule: For a Long Packet with zero-byte payload, Packet Footer SHALL be 0xFFFF (the initial CRC value, since no payload bytes shifted in).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Implementations that emit Footer 0x0000 for zero-length payload will trigger Checksum Error (bit 10) on any v1.01-compliant receiver that implements Checksum check.

backward_compat_traps.rule: If a peripheral does not calculate the Checksum on its outgoing Long Packet, it SHALL transmit 0x0000 in the Packet Footer.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Receiver must disable Checksum check when communicating with non-checksum-capable peripheral (host-controlled enable per §10.6).

backward_compat_traps.rule: DSI v1.01.00 VC field is 2 bits (DI[7:6]) and supports up to 4 Virtual Channels.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Confusion with CSI-2 v1.2+ which widens VC to 4 bits via VC extension; DSI v1.01.00 does NOT have VC extension.

backward_compat_traps.rule: P6 and P7 bits of ECC byte are unused and SHALL be 0 by transmitter; receiver SHALL ignore P6/P7 and force them to 0 before processing.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Receivers that include P6/P7 in syndrome computation will mis-decode every header.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Trigger Message byte 0x5D (LSB-first 10111010) is RESERVED by DSI for Tearing Effect signaling only and SHALL NOT be used for any other purpose.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Vendor-specific overload of 0x5D for non-TE signaling breaks interoperability.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Host LP clock frequency SHALL be 67%..150% of peripheral LP clock frequency (3:2 ratio max).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Outside this band, BTA Escape Mode handshake may fail; peripheral implementer must declare nominal LP frequency + accuracy.

backward_compat_traps.rule: LP RX-Host Timeout (LRX-H_TO) MUST be set longer than LP TX-Peripheral Timeout (LTX-P_TO) so the peripheral has returned to LP-RX before host LP-RX timer expires.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Reversed ordering causes host to time out before peripheral hands back the bus, locking the Link until reset.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Data Type codes with DT[3:0] = 0b0000 or 0b1111 SHALL NOT be used (DO NOT USE class).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Vendor-defined custom DT values must avoid these patterns; DT encoding guarantees at least one 0-1 or 1-0 transition in DT[3:0].

fields.version_naming_history_note: MIPI Alliance maintains the DSI Display Serial Interface specification, the DCS Display Command Set, the DBI-2 / DPI-2 parallel display interfaces it supersedes, and the D-PHY physical layer specification. DSI v1.01.00 (Feb 2008) is the first revision to include EoTp. Subsequent DSI releases (v1.02 onward, v1.3, v2.x) — not covered by this document — added more pixel formats, higher data rates aligned with later D-PHY revisions, and additional command types.
